title: feat(state): union read across a principal's granted partitions
context:
A key that opens two drawers had to read them one at a time
(fnd_a16aee3105). ReadRequest gains an optional `scopes` list; the
served read resolves every granted entry, reads each partition with the
same subject/task/facets, and merges into one state_of_record: refs and
depends_on concatenated (each ref carries its scope), invalidated_by and
denied_scopes unioned, records merged by id. ReadResponse gains `scopes`
(partitions actually read, primary first) and `receipts` (one delivery
receipt per  Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex).
decision: Introduced src/core, src/serve, src/store, test/serve.test.ts, test/state-binding.test.ts: added mergeReadResponses, dedupeRefs, hdr, ref.
